content.value: . Is single -phase induction motor self-starting? Explain with proper schematics.

<sub>7(c).</sub> A <sub>3-phasc,</sub> slip ring, induction motor with star-connected rotor has an induced emf of 120 V between slip rings at stand still with normal voltage applied to stator. The rotor winding has a resistance per phase of 0.3 ohm and standstill leakage reactance per phase of 1.5 ohm. Calculate: i) rotor current/phase when running short-circuited with 4% slip and ii) the slip and rotor current per phase when rotor is developing maximum torque.
